/metaverse/.title: The experience map
/metaverse/.intro: A virtual world is only as valuable as the experience inside it.

work.title: Worlds made real
work.bridge: Ideas are only interesting when they become something.

/mixed-reality/.title: Real world + digital layer
/mixed-reality/.intro: Mixed Reality becomes useful when the physical setting and the digital element have a clear relationship.
steps: The physical environment gives the experience context.
The digital object adds information, possibility or perspective.
People examine, manipulate or understand something through the relationship.
The experience needs a reason beyond technical possibility.

work.title: When digital meets the real world
work.bridge: Ideas become useful when the physical and digital meet with purpose.

/virtual-reality/.title: The VR experience journey
/virtual-reality/.intro: The headset is the interface. The experience is everything behind it.
steps: The audience enters a new environment.
The environment gives them a reason to explore.
They become part of the experience.
The experience stays with them after they leave.

work.title: Inside the idea
work.bridge: The most immersive ideas need to become something people can enter.

/augment-reality/.title: The AR discovery path
/augment-reality/.intro: The best AR experiences can feel surprisingly simple.
steps: A user sees something in the world they already occupy.
They choose to activate a contextual digital layer.
Information, story or interaction appears where it matters.
The experience gives them something meaningful to do.
The technology becomes invisible and the experience becomes memorable.

work.title: A layer worth discovering
work.bridge: The strongest digital layer gives the real world another reason to be explored.

/animation/.title: From thought to moving image
/animation/.intro: A strong animation is not simply beautiful. It has a reason to move.
steps: What should the world look like?
How should every frame be built?

work.title: Frame by frame
work.bridge: Movement becomes meaningful when every frame serves the story.

/brand-advertisement/.title: From campaign to ecosystem
/brand-advertisement/.intro: A campaign can begin with one idea and expand across connected ways of communicating.
steps: A clear thought gives communication a reason to exist.
The thought becomes something an audience can understand.
Visual language gives the message a recognizable form.
Film, animation and digital material give it momentum.
The work meets people where they can notice and remember it.

work.title: Ideas in public
work.bridge: A campaign comes alive when an idea becomes something audiences can encounter.

/media-production/.title: From pre-production to final frame
/media-production/.intro: Production is where the idea becomes real.
steps: Understand the idea and the audience.
Shape narrative, sequence and visual storytelling.
Define people, plan and production requirements.
Bring the idea into cameras, animation, sound and performance.
Edit, animate, design and complete the story.
Prepare the final experience for its intended platform.

work.title: From idea to final frame
work.bridge: Production gives an idea its final form.
